_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. deezer.com declares its Tempo design-token layer in its stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant scales under core.* and a semantic --tempo-colors-*/--color-*/--background-*/--text-*/--divider-* layer emitted under both light.* and dark.* so each theme resolves its own value. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match.
